lessons.title: Etymological Strata (Greek, French, Latin, Germanic)
grammar: Decoding rules conditioned by linguistic origin of lexical strata
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-C1-001"
cando: "Can identify word origin and apply appropriate stratum-specific decoding rules."
task: "Sort CH words into Greek, French, and Germanic groups."
speaking_focus: "Stratum-sensitive pronunciation."

lessons.title: Transatlantic Pronunciation & Stress Differences (UK vs US)
grammar: Systematic phonological and accentual differences between RP/SSBE and GA
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-C1-002"
cando: "Can contrast and produce British and American stress and vowel variants."
task: "Read passage switching intentionally between UK and US accents."
speaking_focus: "Accent consistency and awareness."

lessons.title: Complex Homographs with Phonological Alternation
grammar: Vowel and consonant shifts in identical graphic forms based on meaning/category
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-C1-003"
cando: "Can select correct pronunciation for homographs in context."
task: "Contextual reading passage with 10 homograph pairs."
speaking_focus: "Context-driven lexical retrieval."
